name: GAPS
summary: Balloon dark-matter search targeting low-energy antideuterons and other cosmic antiparticles. Its first Antarctic science flight launched in December 2025.
detection_principle: Antiparticles slow in Si(Li) and form exotic atoms; characteristic X-rays, annihilation-secondary multiplicities and time of flight provide identification.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
